text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Urinary tract infection and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The mention of diplopia (double vision) alongside progressive weakness makes a urinary tract infection highly unlikely and points toward a neuromuscular junction disorder like Myasthenia Gravis. I need to confirm if your weakness worsens with activity and improves with rest, and I will order a test for acetylcholine receptor antibodies. Please describe the pattern of your weakness in more detail.
